item.title: IoT Temperature and Humidity Sensor Real-Time Monitoring System
item.author: sirichiu8632@gmail.com (Siri Chiu)
item.description: This project uses MQTT with Raspberry Pi, NodeMCU, and ESP8266 to implement a basic IoT system for remote real-time temperature and humidity monitoring.

item.title: Long-Term Care 2.0 Service Integration Platform
item.author: sirichiu8632@gmail.com (Siri Chiu)
item.description: This undergraduate project is a long-term care service integration platform centered on an Android app. The goal is to centralize information flow between care recipients, family members, and service providers. The design focuses on a simple request flow for elderly users, with cloud database storage and FTP-based voice-message upload.
